'''Dumai's Wells ''' is a watering hole of little note most known for the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] that took place there in the last days of {{ne|999}}.

==Location and Description==
The oasis consisted of three stone wells in a small copse. It is located just off the road more than halfway from [[Cairhien]] to [[Tar Valon]], four days from the next available water source at [[Alianelle Spring]]. Its surroundings are described by [[Gawyn Trakand]] as rolling terrain with scattered bunches of trees whose long ridges and low hills were not quite so low as they seemed.

==Origin==
{{dubious|May 2025}}
"Dumai's Wells" (لشيخ ابريق) is a place in Israel close to Megiddo and Nazareth. Megiddo is referred to twelve times in the Old Testament and once in the book of Revelation under its Greek name, [[wikipedia:Armageddon|Armageddon]]. Jordan was likely drawing from this association when he picked the name of a place that is commonly believed to be the site of a great battle prior to the Second Coming of Christ.
